subject: english
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select ‘No substitution required’.**

Sera and Rimi __**has**__ enrolled for the same program.
solution:
The correct answer is **"have."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• According to Subject-Verb agreement rules, compound subjects combined using the conjunction **‘and’ **take a plural verb.
 
• The subject **"Sera and Rimi"** is plural, so it requires a plural verb.
 
• **"Have"** is the correct plural form of the verb "has."
 
 
• **Example: ***Rishi and Karina **have**__ visited them.*
 
 
 
• The correct answer is Option 4.

 

**Correct sentence:** *Sera and Rimi __**have**__ enrolled for the same program. *

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1, **"is",** is the singular form of the verb and does not agree with the plural subject.
 
• Option 3, **"has been"**, is in the present perfect tense and implies a completed action in the past, which is not accurate in this context.
